scripts.dev: export NODE_ENV=development && pnpm run build && pnpm run start
scripts.test: pnpm run test:contract & first=$!; pnpm run test:contract & second=$!; status=0; wait "$first" || status=$?; wait "$second" || status=$?; exit "$status"
scripts.test:contract: tmp="/tmp/analysis-engine.test.$$.cjs"; trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT; esbuild src/lib/analysis-engine.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile="$tmp" && NODE_ENV=production node --test "$tmp"
